source_claim: Nippon TV's official catalog identifies KAIJI as a live-action adaptation of Nobuyuki Fukumoto's Kaiji comic series and explicitly names Kaiji Ito (伊藤カイジ) as its main character.
notes: The broadcaster's catalog ties the character directly to the manga property, rather than relying on co-occurrence.

source_claim: Nippon TV's official product page describes Yukio Tonegawa as one of the characters in Tobaku Mokushiroku Kaiji and names him as the central character of the Tonegawa spin-off.
notes: The page explicitly states that Tonegawa is a Kaiji character, rather than treating his spin-off appearance as the home.
